content: The management of cardiovascular risk factors in youth with Type 1 Diabetes includes specific guidelines for dyslipidemia screening as recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). An initial lipid profile test should be performed shortly after the diagnosis of Type 1 Diabetes, provided that the individual's glycemic levels have stabilized and they are at least 2 years of age. If the results of the lipid profile indicate normal levels (LDL cholesterol < 100 mg/dL or < 2.6 mmol/L), it is advised to repeat the lipid profile testing every three years.
